about_short_description.short_description: Garage is a marketplace for previously owned equipment, beginning with firefighting apparatus.

product.name: Emergency Vehicles Marketplace
product.description: An online platform for buying and selling used emergency vehicles including fire apparatus, ambulances, and brush trucks.

product.name: Emergency Equipment Marketplace
product.description: A marketplace for purchasing and selling used emergency equipment like nozzles, lights, sirens, and protective gear.

product.name: Municipal Vehicles and Equipment Marketplace
product.description: A platform for buying and selling used municipal vehicles and equipment such as dump trucks, street sweepers, plows, and generators.

product.name: Vehicle and Equipment Appraisal Service
product.description: A free appraisal service for sellers to estimate the value of their emergency vehicles and equipment before listing.

product.name: Freight and Shipping Service
product.description: A service providing instant freight quotes and handling shipping logistics for purchased vehicles and equipment.

product.name: Secure Payment and Payout Service
product.description: A payment processing service that ensures secure and fast transactions for buyers and sellers on the platform.
